subject: Geografia
description_pt: Observar e descrever ritmos naturais (dia e noite, variação de temperatura e umidade etc.) em diferentes escalas espaciais e temporais, comparando a sua realidade com outras.

components.description_pt: Identificar ritmos naturais como dia e noite e variações de temperatura e umidade
components.description_en: Identify natural rhythms such as day and night and variations in temperature and humidity
components.cc_component_description: Explain how Earth's rotation on its axis causes the pattern of day and night

components.description_pt: Descrever ritmos naturais observados em diferentes escalas espaciais e temporais
components.description_en: Describe natural rhythms observed across different spatial and temporal scales
components.cc_component_description: Compare patterns observed at different scales of a system to identify scale-dependent phenomena

components.description_pt: Comparar ritmos naturais vivenciados com aqueles de outros lugares
components.description_en: Compare natural rhythms experienced in their own reality with those of other places

cc_matches.description: Different patterns may be observed at each of the scales at which a system is studied and can provide evidence for causality in explanations of phenomena.

The orbits of Earth around the sun and of the moon around Earth, together with the rotation of Earth about an axis between its North and South poles, cause observable patterns. These include day and night; daily changes in the length and direction of shadows; and different positions of the sun, moon, and stars at different times of the day, month, and year.
